jobs.description_text: ABOUT There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. ROLE Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications. Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment. This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users. FOCUS - Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization. - Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost. - Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking. - Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy. - Develop evaluation pipelines, labeled datasets and metrics to measure model quality. - Fine-tune and adapt existing models when supported by sufficient data. - Build and maintain ML training, inference and deployment pipelines. - Debug production issues, monitor model performance and ship improvements based on real-world feedback. TECH STACK - Python - PyTorch / JAX - Embeddings, vector search and ranking models - Production ML systems and inference pipelines IDEAL EXPERIENCE - Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures. - Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models in production. - Experience in classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation systems or personalization. - Understanding of model evaluation, experimentation and performance metrics. - Comfortable writing production-quality code and working with real-world datasets. - Able to balance model quality, latency, cost and reliability. - Strong ownership, problem-solving skills OUTCOMES - ML models in production meet expected accuracy, relevance, latency and reliability targets. - Classification and ranking improvements deliver measurable gains in model quality. - Evaluation pipelines identify regressions and support reliable model releases. - Training, inference and data pipelines are robust, reproducible and maintainable. - Model improvements are driven by real-world feedback and measurable results. - Collaborates effectively with engineering and product teams to deliver reliable ML-powered features. HOW WE WORK The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. We are a high-talent-density, hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move quickly, balancing high-quality work with continuous learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put a truly magical product into the hands of our users. INTERVIEW PROCESS If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted virtually and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. THE ROLE We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent. This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app. - Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services. - Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations. - Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly. - Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners. - Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance. - Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3+ years of backend engineering experience. - Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging. - Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems. - Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases. - Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk. - Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams. - Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage. THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT - Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams. - Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact. - Can move fast without creating fragile foundations. - Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability. - Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR - Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks. - People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk. - Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements. - Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems. - People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership. LOCATION This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore. LANGUAGE English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. INTERVIEW PROCESS Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
